# Phase 06: SEO-Technical
**Project:** Suffolk County Residential Roofing Website
**Spec:** `suffolk-roofing-spec-v3.md` (🔒 LOCKED v3)
**Build Plan:** `BUILDPLAN.md`
**Prerequisites:** Phase 01, 03a, 03b, 03c, 04
**Implements:** F-006, F-007, F-017, F-015 (Search Console), F-018 (indexing)
**Recommended:** `claude --max-turns 50`

---

## 1. Context
You are executing **Phase 06: SEO-Technical** — JSON-LD by page type, split XML sitemaps, 301 redirect discipline, and the internal-linking / anchor-ratio check. **Scope is strictly this phase.** Pages already exist; you add structured data and linking, not content.

**Tech Stack:** Astro + Sanity. **Working Directory:** project root. **Spec File:** read §2.2, §4.4 + SOW §5, §8 first.

### What Already Exists
Phases 03a/03b/03c/04 render all service/town/core pages (exposing FAQ/review data). Deps installed — **no `npm install`.**

### What You're Building
Structured data emitters, sitemaps, redirects, and a CI anchor-ratio check across the rendered site.

---

## 2. Objective & Deliverables
### Objective
After this phase, every page type emits valid JSON-LD, sitemaps split by content type, redirects are disciplined, and exact-match anchor text is capped ≤30% site-wide.
### Deliverables
1. JSON-LD by page type (`RoofingContractor`, `Service`, `FAQPage`, `BreadcrumbList`, `Review`/`AggregateRating`) — spec §2.2, §4, SOW §8.
2. Split XML sitemaps by content type — spec §4.4, SOW §8 (F-017).
3. 301 redirect discipline — SOW §8.
4. Internal-linking model + ≤30% exact-match anchor-ratio CI check — spec §4.4, SOW §5 (F-006).

---

## 3. Implementation Instructions
### Task 1: JSON-LD emitters
**Spec:** §2.2, §4.
> **CAUTION.** `Review`/`AggregateRating` JSON-LD is emitted **only from a real, auditable feed**, and **suppressed when `lastSyncedAt` > freshness threshold** (§2.2). Recompute `AggregateRating` only from present reviews (reconciled Google deletions). Do not emit review schema from placeholder data.

### Task 2: Sitemaps + redirects
**Spec:** §4.4, SOW §8. Split XML sitemaps by content type (town/service/post/core); canonical self-referencing URLs; 301 redirect discipline (no chains/loops).

### Task 3: Internal linking + anchor-ratio check
**Spec:** §4.4, SOW §5. Town↔service, town↔town (2–4 adjacent), blog↔money-page, breadcrumbs; no page >2 clicks from home. A CI check asserts exact-match "[service] [town]" anchors ≤30% site-wide.

---

## 4. Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Standing gate green; `npm run build` exits 0
- [ ] Each page type emits valid JSON-LD (FAQPage passes Rich Results-style validation in test)
- [ ] Review/AggregateRating JSON-LD emitted only from real feed data and suppressed when stale
- [ ] Split sitemaps generated by content type; all canonical URLs self-referencing
- [ ] Redirects are single-hop 301s (no chains/loops)
- [ ] **Anchor-ratio CI check fails when exact-match anchors exceed 30%, passes otherwise**
- [ ] No page is >2 clicks from home (link-graph check)

---

## 5. Constraints
### Hard
- **Tool allowlist only.** **No `npm install`. No `git push`.**
- No review schema from placeholder/non-auditable data.
- Do NOT modify page content or build new pages.
### Soft
- `// SPEC-AMBIGUITY` / `// BLOCKED`; reference spec sections by number.

---

## 6. Completion Protocol
Files Created/Modified; Acceptance Criteria Results; Ambiguities; Blocked Items; Decisions; **Warnings for Next Phase** (which structured-data/perf hooks Phase 07 audits). Maintain `PHASE-06-PROGRESS.md`.

---

## 7. Execution & Orchestration
- **Recommended:** `claude --max-turns 50`. **Resumption:** re-read prompt, inspect filesystem, read `PHASE-06-PROGRESS.md`, resume at first incomplete task.
- **Autonomy:** defined → exact; silent → `// SPEC-AMBIGUITY`; contradictory → `// ESCALATE` + skip.
